assets.name: original-desert-airbase-art
assets.description: Authored terrain, airbase and town structures, oasis plants and lakes, missile, undercarriage, surface panel artwork, cannon flash, smoke and tracer materials, and synthesized nonvoice audio created for this game by retained art scripts
assets.used_for: 20 km desert arena, distant scenic Gobi ground, defended airbase, missile geometry, parked aircraft undercarriage, coherent surface detail and sound feedback
assets.changes: Created for this project by retained Scripts/build_art_v1.py; distant ground ring by Scripts/build_horizon_v1.py; sound boundaries polished by Scripts/prepare_audio_v1.py; material and exposure repairs retained as versioned polish_environment scripts; original soft cannon flash, smoke, tapered tracer and projectile-head HLSL materials authored by Scripts/build_cannon_fx_v1.py; detailed settlement and flora by build_settlement_art_v2.py; ridges, lakes and roads by build_terrain_variation_v2.py; terrain-conforming banks by refine_oasis_surfaces_v1.py
